title: Require exact method matches in WebView command audit
summary: Require exact HTTP method and normalized-path matching for WebView command contracts and method-specific ownership where one path exposes distinct read and write owners.
reason: Remediate P2 AUDIT-FIND-W10-CHM-001. The canonical Node prework audit currently falls back from an exact method/path miss to any contract sharing the path, allowing a wrong-method frontend call to inherit the other method's effect and pass as documented.
behavior_before: A POST usage could match a GET-only contract, or a GET usage could match a POST-only contract, because path-only lookup was accepted after an exact tuple miss.
behavior_after: Only the exact HTTP method and normalized path can supply contract metadata; same-path alternate methods are diagnostic suggestions and the usage remains an undocumented-route violation. The shared priority-export path separately permits its documented Launch GET owner and Queue POST owner.
tests_added: A Node-backed Python regression fixture covers GET-only/POST-requested, POST-only/GET-requested, and exact-method matches, including proof that mismatches never inherit contract effects and that priority-export ownership is method-specific.
manual_validation: AUDIT-FIND-W10-CHM-001 reproduced against current bytes: POST /api/example inherited a GET-only contract through the path-only fallback, producing contract_found=true and the GET effect.

Bundled pytest tests/webview/test_webview_command_boundary_audit.py - passed (6 tests), including GET-only/POST and POST-only/GET mismatch fixtures, exact-match control, no inherited mismatch effect, production matcher wiring, and method-specific priority-export ownership.
npm run webview:commands regenerated docs/generated/WEBVIEW_COMMAND_BOUNDARY_AUDIT.json; npm run webview:commands:check passed with zero violations and current evidence.
ops/scripts/smoke/Test-WebViewCommandEvidenceSmoke.ps1 - passed (1 test, 0 skipped); temporary backend/WebView fixture only, with no media or operator-state mutation.
npm run webview:check, webview:map:check, webview:slices:check, webview:dom-gaps:check, and webview:script-order:smoke passed; script-order loaded 287 assets and verified required globals.

npm run webview:prework:check remains unavailable as an aggregate pass because unrelated pre-existing ESLint budget drift stops it at 1,389 versus 1,387 warnings; direct later checks also found unrelated stale WEBVIEW_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_BASELINE.json, WEBVIEW_ROUTE_OWNERSHIP_GUARD.json, and WEBVIEW_TOUCHPOINT_LEDGER.json. These baselines were not ratcheted or absorbed into this packet.

Generated-context tooling passed (30 tests / 70 subtests); architecture guardrails passed (90 candidates); risky-file registry passed; god-file guard remained at the accepted 0 errors / 51 warnings baseline.
Targeted summaries were refreshed for the packet, audit script, and regression test; project index, dependency graph, and feature map regenerated from 2,496 typed records.
Summary freshness retained only five unrelated pre-existing stale summaries after the final packet-summary refresh.
Final project-index and feature-map check modes passed; validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage passed; git diff --check passed with line-ending warnings only.
rollback_plan: Revert the exact matcher, import-safe main guard, regression fixture, generated summaries/maps, and this packet together. Do not restore path-only contract success.
notes: Protected invariant: the command-boundary gate must classify frontend calls against the backend's exact method/path contract before assigning effects or high-risk status. Required validation: focused audit tests, webview:commands:check, webview:prework:check, command-evidence smoke, generated-context checks, and strict packet coverage. No backend routes, command journal semantics, media policy, or filesystem mutation changes; representative real-media validation is not required.
